svg.title: MUSE — Complete Database ERD
svg.text: All 64 tables and all 124 foreign-key relationships. Key columns only (PK, FK, unique keys); every other attribute is in docs/DATA_DICTIONARY.md. Generated from the live MySQL schema (baseline 01–06 + migrations 0001, 0002, 0003, 0004) by backend/scripts/erd/build_erd.py.

g.title: lg_notes
g.text: Crow's foot = many · bar = one · circle = zero (optional)
Solid line: identifying (FK is part of the child's PK)
PK primary key · FK foreign key
UK, U1, U2: unique key (same tag = one composite key)
